Figure S2.CABA-201 demonstrates activity in vivo.Luciferase-expressing Nalm6 cells (1 × 10 6 cells per mouse) were injected intravenously into NSG mice, followed 5 days later by injection with 1 × 10 7 NTD T-cells, FMC63 CART cells, or CABA-201 cells.Bioluminescence imaging quantification of Nalm6 CD19 + cells after FMC63 CART, CABA-201 or NTD treatment for days 1, 4, 7, 9, 11, 16, 24, 29, 37, 43, and 50  were plotted as mean ± SD for each group (n=12 for NTD and n=18 for FMC63-CART and CABA-201 group).NTD T-cells treated group mice were terminated on day 28 for humane reasons.

Transduction efficiency of CAR and cell expansion during generation of CABA-201 cells from multiple autoimmune disease patient materials and types are shown.Donors with less than 5-fold cell expansions were largely due to poor quality of frozen PBMC samples.
